definitions.explanation: A prefix attached to time words to indicate the next occurrence of that time period.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび}に{会|あ}いましょう。
{来年|らいねん}は{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan next year.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}が{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: A new job starts from next month.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{来週|らいしゅう} (next week)
・{来月|らいげつ} (next month)
・{来年|らいねん} (next year)
・{来学期|らいがっき} (next semester)
・{来春|らいしゅん}/{来春|らいはる} (next spring)
・{来日|らいにち} (coming to Japan - special meaning)

SPECIAL USAGE: 来日 (らいにち) means 'coming to Japan' (visiting Japan), not 'next day' (which is {翌日|よくじつ} or {明日|あした}).

CONTRAST:
・{来|らい}〜 (next) vs {今|こん}〜 (this) vs {先|せん}〜 (last/previous)
・{来週|らいしゅう} ↔ {今週|こんしゅう} ↔ {先週|せんしゅう}
